claims.text: Hermitage Bay sits on Antigua's west coast, and its namesake bay is shared with no one else.

findings.quote: Hermitage Bay sits alone on Antigua’s west coast, its namesake bay shared with no one else.

claims.text: Hermitage Bay opened to visitors around the winter holidays in 2006.

findings.quote: around the winter holidays in 2006, Hermitage Bay finally opened up to visitors

claims.text: Each villa has air conditioning, an outdoor shower and a generous stand-alone tub.

findings.quote: Each villa comes with air conditioning, an outdoor shower, and a generous stand-alone tub.

claims.text: Rattan accents, white linens and mosquito-netted beds give the rooms a Balinese-esque look, with hideaway TVs.

findings.quote: Rattan accents, white linens, and mosquito-netted beds create a Balinese-esque look, while hideaway TVs encourage you to unplug a little

claims.text: The open-air spa is wrapped in lush gardens, with the sea before it.

findings.quote: Our open-air spa is wrapped in lush gardens, with the sea before you.

claims.text: Every spa treatment is performed with ESPA.

findings.quote: Every treatment is performed with ESPA, pairing natural ingredients with modern therapeutic techniques.

claims.text: There is a Technogym fitness center, with personal training available on request.

findings.quote: Keep your routine or try something new in our Technogym fitness center, with personal training available on request.

claims.text: Guests can choose an all-inclusive plan or bed and breakfast.

findings.quote: Choose the all-inclusive plan, or keep things simple with bed and breakfast

claims.text: The resort grows many of its own seasonal fruits, vegetables and herbs in an on-site organic garden.

findings.quote: we grow many of our own seasonal fruits, vegetables, and herbs right here on the resort in our organic garden

claims.text: The circular Tree Bar is tucked beneath the branches at the edge of the beach.

findings.quote: Tucked beneath the branches at the edge of the beach, the circular Tree Bar is where the day slows down and the evening begins.

claims.text: Many of the staff have been at the resort for more than a decade.

findings.quote: In our home-grown family of staff, many of whom have been here more than a decade, kindness is paramount.

claims.text: Snorkeling, paddleboarding and kayaking gear are available.

findings.quote: Snorkeling, paddleboarding, and kayaking gear are available, too.

claims.text: The villas are scattered between the hillside and the shore, and every one has a private pool or hot tub.

findings.quote: villas are scattered between the hillside and the shore. Some are steps from the water, others tucked into the trees, and all have a private pool or hot tub.

claims.text: The Hillside Ocean Pool Villas sit high on the hillside with views over Hermitage Bay and an unobstructed sunset each night.

findings.quote: Perched high on our hillside, these secluded villas offer the ultimate views over Hermitage Bay.
these offer an unobstructed sunset each night

claims.text: The Sanctuary is a private three-bedroom villa with a sun terrace, sauna, cold plunge and jacuzzi pavilion.

findings.quote: A private three-bedroom Caribbean villa with calming living spaces, set in the heart of Hermitage Bay. A sun terrace, sauna, cold plunge, and jacuzzi pavilion

claims.text: Yoga, meditation and Pilates take place daily above the sea.

findings.quote: Yoga, meditation, and Pilates take place daily above the sea, with the ocean breeze as part of the practice.

claims.text: Two speed boats and a 103-foot sailboat are on property for boating trips, deep sea fishing and sunset cruises.

findings.quote: two speed boats (29- and 44-feet, respectively) and a 103-foot sailboat are now on property and available for guests to enjoy boating trips around the island or head out on deep sea fishing trips and sunset cruises

claims.text: The resort is on the western side of the island, with nothing within walking distance.

findings.quote: Situated on the western side of the island, there's nothing within walking distance.

claims.text: Because the property is very much on the beach, some spaces may be hard to navigate for guests with mobility issues.

findings.quote: This property is very much on the beach, so it may be tough for those with mobility issues to navigate certain spaces

claims.text: Large electronics are largely discouraged around the property.

findings.quote: large electronics are largely discouraged around the property
